sections.heading: A — Exam authority
sections.markdown:
## A — Exam authority

The selected pages of this section cover provisional night rules, driver license categories and endorsements, the performance test, renewal, duplicate and restricted licenses, registry, donor and veteran notations, mopeds, license display and citations; they describe the driver performance test for category three, the special written and skills examinations for categories one and two, and the commercial skills test for category four, but they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit for the knowledge test.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: license categories, renewal periods and citation types are statutory facts printed in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the provisional night rules, driver license categories and endorsements, the performance test, renewal, duplicate and restricted licenses, registry, donor and veteran notations, mopeds, license display and citations rules on pages 14–17 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
